defects.claim: the receipts digest still shows the per-run cost for every key source except `platform`, so runs with `unknown` or empty key_source get a cost line, but the issue allows the cost line only on the tenant's own key
defects.evidence: the condition is `exec.KeySource != memory.KeySourcePlatform`, and internal/memory/store.go:866 reads `COALESCE(NULLIF(key_source, ''), 'unknown')`. So the founder-tenant case from project memory (key_source=unknown on every execution) gets cost lines in the Telegram digest. The structured path at internal/briefs/structured.go:77 does this correctly with `== KeySourceOwn`, so the two disagree.
